# Robert Brown

Robert Brown has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2004 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-brown#e5)

  Not elected.

## Election History

### 2004 Senator By-Election

By-election following the resignation of Christopher Lakeman (1 seat), 24th March 2004.

**Robert Brown was not elected**.
